patterns.note: Full-bleed sections with content centered horizontally, often using a distinctive distressed or 'torn paper' graphic as a top border for visual separation.
Headings are consistently large, bold, and uppercase sans-serif, creating a strong, impactful visual hierarchy against dark backgrounds.
A dominant deep indigo/navy blue background is contrasted with bright yellow accents and crisp white typography for high visibility and a bold aesthetic.
Sections reveal with a subtle fade-up or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, while hero elements like stars exhibit a gentle parallax effect against the scrolling background.
Key content sections frequently incorporate full-width video backgrounds or large, evocative imagery to set a mood and provide dynamic visual interest.

technique_notes: Sections are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, likely a combination of CSS keyframes and JavaScript, causing elements to fade or slide into view from the bottom as they become visible. The hero features a subtle parallax effect on background elements to add depth. Video backgrounds are used in key content sections to create an immersive experience.
Visual breaks between sections are achieved using a full-width, distressed graphic that mimics torn paper, providing a unique textured transition rather than a clean line.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, uppercase sans-serif headings (up to ~4-5x body text) create a strong, assertive presence, while body text remains highly legible.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on interactive elements and image containers, with some instances of pill-shaped elements for calls to action.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, allowing elements to breathe and stand out on the dark canvas.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a deep, cosmic blue palette with bright yellow accents, combined with unique 'torn paper' section dividers and subtle star animations, creates a dreamlike yet bold and energetic aesthetic. The '094 LOADING...' interstitial section also adds a memorable, almost game-like touch.
